[[Kurzick Mesmer]]s help to defend the gates during the [[Fort Aspenwood]] [[competitive mission]]. There are two between the inner and outer colored gates that do not respawn and two in front of the inner green gate that do respawn. They are also occasionally seen in raids against [[Luxon]]s in the Jade Sea.
